title: #inc-2207 (restricted): private-feed tokens in private-feeds application logs

messages.text: INC-2207 declared by @sec-ir. Sev2. Restricted. IC: @sec-lead.
detection rule secrets-in-logs/private-feed-token fired at 04:38. `pft_` tokens in the private-feeds app logs, full request URLs with `?token=`. first hit 2026-09-10 14:22
yes. v2.31.0 went out 2026-09-10 14:20 with the logging library bump. the new request logger prints the query string at INFO. fix is LOG_QUERY_STRINGS=false, deploying now
counting distinct tokens in pf-app-2026.09.10 through pf-app-2026.09.15. will take a few min
payouts-worker got the same library bump in that dependency PR. the batch at 06:00 handles bank account references. I want payouts logs checked before it runs. @jh can you hold it?
holding. `flagctl set payouts.batch_enabled false --reason INC-2207`. creators will see the money late today, I'll post in #incidents without details
v2.31.1 with LOG_QUERY_STRINGS=false is out. no new pft_ hits since 05:40
rotate all 1,912. no grace period. subscribers get the new-link email

ack, expected, batch is on hold for this incident
